title: fix(spec): re-point the app liveness ledger off objectui's removed AppSidebar; branding.logo is planned
body:
Fixes #20146
Clause-②: no

Twelve `AppSchema` rows in `packages/spec/liveness/app.json`, and the file `_note`, cited objectui's `AppSidebar.tsx` as read evidence. `AppSidebar` was deprecated (objectui#5720), never mounted (the console renders `UnifiedSidebar`), and objectui PR #10617 (objectui#5817) has removed it from objectui main. So it was never evidence of a live reader. This PR re-points every one of those rows to the reader that is actually mounted, file and symbol, with no line numbers. It moves `branding.logo` to `planned` with carrier objectui#10827, and fixes the two `AppSidebar` prose mentions in `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`.

Ledger evidence and comment prose only. ⛔ No schema, parse or accept-set change; no `.describe()` and no refusal text changed.

## Which sha the rows cite, and why

All re-pointed readers are cited as `objectui @f8a9d0fb`, the `.objectui-sha` pin this repo builds against. That is the convention the `navigation.runAction` row states ("read at the pin this repo builds against, not at objectui main").

- The pin **still carries** `AppSidebar.tsx`: `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppSidebar.tsx` is present at `f8a9d0fb` and absent at objectui main `fb91ac9b0`. At the pin its only references are the two barrel exports (`packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` and `packages/app-shell/src/layout/index.ts`, both marked deprecated), tests and comments. Its one JSX occurrence outside tests is a usage example inside a doc comment (`providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx`). There is no mount site. That is why the old pointers kept resolving while proving nothing.
- Every named reader file exists at the pin. Every reader was re-read there. **Control per row:** the same read, re-run at objectui main `fb91ac9b0` (after the removal), answers identically. So the next pin bump does not strand these pointers.
- `check:liveness` attributes a path after an `objectui` realm marker to the other repo. It counts that path and never resolves it (`packages/spec/scripts/liveness/evidence.mts#scanEvidence`). A realm marker only reaches the next `;` or closing paren, so every clause carries its own `objectui @f8a9d0fb:` marker. The gate's foreign-pointer count moves 202 → 218, and its local-path (614) and symbol-anchor (758) counts are unchanged.

## Row → reader, at objectui `@f8a9d0fb`

| row | mounted reader (file · symbol) | what it reads | control at objectui main `fb91ac9b0` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `label` | `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppSwitcher.tsx` · `AppSwitcher`; `.../layout/ConsoleLayout.tsx` · `ConsoleLayout`; `.../console/home/HomeAppsStrip.tsx` · `HomeAppsStrip` | `resolveKeyedI18nLabel(activeApp.label, t)` on the pill and `app.label` per row; `appLabel` into `AppHeader` plus the `AppShell` branding title; launcher tiles | same reads |
| `description` | `apps/console/src/pages/system/AppManagementPage.tsx` · `AppManagementPage` (routed at `system/apps`) | each list row renders `resolveKeyedI18nLabel(app.description, t)`; `filteredApps` searches it | same reads |
| `icon` | `AppSwitcher.tsx` · `AppSwitcher`; `HomeAppsStrip.tsx` · `HomeAppsStrip` | `getIcon(app.icon)` per row / per tile | same reads |
| `branding.primaryColor` | `ConsoleLayout.tsx` · `ConsoleLayout` into `packages/layout/src/AppShell.tsx` · `useAppShellBranding` | handed to `AppShell`'s `branding`; mapped onto `--primary` / `--ring` / `--sidebar-primary` | same reads |
| `branding.accentColor` | same handoff | mapped onto `--accent` | same reads |
| `branding.favicon` | same handoff | sets the favicon link's href | same reads |
| `branding.logo` | **none mounted** → `planned` | see below | no reader at main either |
| `active` | `AppSwitcher`; `.../layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx` · `UnifiedSidebar`; `.../utils/appRoute.ts` · `filterActiveApps`; `.../layout/AppHeader.tsx` · `AppHeader` | `a.active !== false` in the switcher list, the sidebar's list and active-app lookup, the openable-apps predicate (called by `HomePage`, `app-launcher-renderer`, `resolveHostAppSegment`), and the avatar menu | same reads |
| `hidden` | `AppSwitcher`; `UnifiedSidebar`; `filterActiveApps`; `AppHeader` | `a.hidden !== true` out of the lists; the avatar menu lists `a.hidden === true` apps (Account excepted); the in-repo `ACCOUNT_APP` leg is unchanged | same reads |
| `navigation[].id` | `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` · `useNavOrder` and `UnifiedSidebar` (`useNavPins`); `packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx` · `NavigationRenderer`; `.../views/nav-menu-renderer.tsx` · `NavMenuRenderer` | persisted reorder by id; pins; sortable id, render keys, active row | same reads |
| `navigation[].visible` | `UnifiedSidebar` · `evalVis`; `NavMenuRenderer` · `evalVis` | CEL through `evaluateVisibility`, into `NavigationRenderer` and `hasVisibleNavigationItems`; per-row skip when false (the `NavigationRenderer` item-gate leg is unchanged) | same reads |
| `areas[].id` | `UnifiedSidebar` | `activeAreaId` state and the lookup by `a.id`; each area row's key and click | same reads |
| `areas[].label` | `UnifiedSidebar` | `resolveInlineI18nLabel(area.label, language)` | same reads |
| `areas[].icon` | `UnifiedSidebar` | `getIcon(area.icon)` | same reads |
| `areas[].navigation` | `UnifiedSidebar` (the `AppSchemaRenderer` leg is unchanged) | the active area's `navigation` replaces the app's top-level tree | same reads |
| file `_note` | shell list re-pointed to UnifiedSidebar / AppSwitcher / AppHeader / ConsoleLayout / ContextSelectors, HomeAppsStrip, NavigationRenderer / AppShell, RootLandingRedirect / AppManagementPage | plus a dated paragraph recording the sha choice | — |

Mount sites, measured at the pin: `UnifiedSidebar` in `ConsoleLayout`; `AppSwitcher` in `AppHeader`; `HomeAppsStrip` in `HomePage` and `app-launcher-renderer`; `nav-menu-renderer` registered by import in `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`; `AppManagementPage` on the console route `system/apps`.

## `description`: still `live`, narrower

The one mounted reader is the admin app list (`/system/apps`). The card asked whether `AppManagementPage` still makes the row `live`, and it does. Its `apps` come from `useMetadata()`, the app metadata list, and the page is routed. The "under the active app's title" presentation has **no successor**. Not counted: `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/AppCard.tsx` also reads `app.description`, but at the pin it is only barrel-exported (no mount site), which is the same trap `AppSidebar` was.

## `branding.logo` → `planned` (carrier objectui#10827)

`branding` is now **drilled**, so `logo` gets its own verdict while `primaryColor`, `accentColor` and `favicon` keep `live`. Census at the pin, with the same grep run for `branding.primaryColor` as the positive control (it hits `ConsoleLayout` and `AppShell`):

- **Authored** (the row's `producer`): `packages/plugin-designer/src/AppCreationWizard.tsx` · `AppCreationWizard` and `BrandingEditor.tsx` · `BrandingEditor` write it with a preview; `pages/EditAppPage.tsx` · `EditAppPage` pre-fills from it.
- **Rendered by nothing mounted.** The only reader of `branding.logo` in app-shell or layout at the pin is `AppSidebar` (unmounted). At main there is none. `ConsoleLayout` hands `AppShell` `primaryColor` / `accentColor` / `favicon` and never `logo`, and `AppShellBranding` has no logo field. `EmbeddableForm`'s `config.branding.logo` is a form embed config, and `runtime-config.ts`'s `branding.logoUrl` is console runtime config; neither is the app key.
- **The nearest thing to a read:** `packages/types/src/app.ts` · `wizardDraftToAppSchema` copies `draft.branding.logo` into a top-level `logo`, and `packages/layout/src/AppSchemaRenderer.tsx` · `InternalSidebar` renders that top-level `schema.logo`.
- **`authorWarn`: not set,** following the ledger's rules. README "Author warnings" rule 1 bars marking benign display metadata (its examples: `description`, `tags`, `icon`). The `field.useGrouping` precedent is a `planned` row whose consumer is being built: "an author who sets this today loses nothing and is not misled". A logo URL is that case, because it takes effect when objectui#10827 lands, with no re-authoring. `@objectstack/lint` warns on a `planned` row only with an explicit `authorWarn: true` (`packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.ts#shouldWarn`), so author-facing lint output does not change.
- The drill removes `app/branding` from `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/undrilled-containers.baseline.json`, which is shrink-only; the gate fails on a row whose container now drills. Container debt goes from 110 containers / 569 keys to 109 / 565.

### Spelling (Zone 1 measured)

`AppSchema` declares only `branding.logo`. A top-level `logo` on an app is **refused**, not folded:

```text
AppSchema.safeParse({ name: 'probe_app', label: 'Probe', logo: 'https://x/l.png' })
  -> unrecognized_keys, path [], keys ['logo']
     "Unrecognized key(s) on this app: `logo`. Did you mean `logo` → `branding`? ..."
AppSchema.safeParse({ name: 'probe_app', label: 'Probe', branding: { logo: 'https://x/l.png' } })
  -> accepted, branding.logo kept
```

The alias table (`logo: 'branding'`) feeds the refusal's "did you mean". It does not rewrite the key (`packages/spec/src/shared/strict-object.ts` header), and no ADR-0087 conversion carries `logo`. So the conclusion holds (one declared spelling, nothing to retire), and the word "folds" in the dispatch and in objectui#10827's spelling paragraph is imprecise.

## One note corrected while re-reading

The `active` note said the sidebar's active-app lookup "spans all apps so a direct /apps/NAME URL keeps rendering". At the pin, that comment is about **hidden** apps. The sidebar lookup filters `active !== false`. What keeps an inactive app routable is app-shell `AppContent`, which resolves `matchAppBySegment(apps, appName)` over all apps. The note now says so. The verdict (`live`, and routing not disabled) is unchanged.

## Prose in `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts` (comments only)

```diff
- * time by the shell (see Console's `AppSidebar` / `AppContent`):
+ * time by the shell (see objectui's `NavigationRenderer`, whose `resolveHref`
+ * substitutes them from the session ids the mounted `UnifiedSidebar` and the
+ * console's `AppContent` supply):
```

Measured at the pin: `NavigationRenderer.tsx` `applyNavTemplate` inside `resolveHref`, fed `templateContext` by `UnifiedSidebar`; `AppContent`'s landing route goes `findFirstRoute` → `buildItemRoute` → `resolveHref` with the session context.

```diff
- * sorted (`NavigationRenderer.tsx:1154`). Area-level order is not — `AppSidebar`
+ * sorted (`NavigationRenderer.tsx:1154`). Area-level order is not — `UnifiedSidebar`
```

Measured at the pin and at main: `UnifiedSidebar` filters then maps `areas` with no sort, and `AppSchemaRenderer` maps `areas` as authored.

## Pins

No test pins these rows' evidence text or the `_note`. `git grep AppSidebar` outside `app.json` hits only the two comments above, plus CHANGELOG and audit history, which are untouched. The tests that read the real ledger (`packages/spec/scripts/liveness/check-liveness.test.ts`, which copies it and mutates `navigation.children.children`) and the consumer suite (`packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.test.ts`) were run; the readings are below. No pin flips.

## Changeset

`.changeset/20146-app-ledger-repoint.md`, `@objectstack/spec: patch`. `liveness/` and `src/**/*.zod.ts` are both in `packages/spec/package.json` `files[]`, and `@objectstack/lint` reads the shipped ledgers at runtime, so this diff publishes. That is why this PR carries no `skip-changeset`.

- **`state-counts.md`** was regenerated with `gen:liveness-counts`, and the gate reads it back as current.
- **Spec package, full `local` project.** Run through the verify lock: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`, exit 0, `Test Files 552 passed (552)`, `Tests 16251 passed | 1 todo (16252)`. This includes `scripts/liveness/check-liveness.test.ts`, which copies and mutates the real ledger.
- **Spec typecheck.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run typecheck` (tsc, then `check:scripts-typecheck`, then `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- **Consumer suite** (`@objectstack/lint` reads the shipped ledgers). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/lint-liveness-properties.test.ts src/component-field-specs-liveness.test.ts`: exit 0, `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 91 passed (91)`.
- **Derived gate families.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, derived from the actual 5 changed paths: 81 commands. 80 exit 0. Reconciled with `--ran`: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 81 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 80 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`, exit 0.
  - **NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`.** Reason: exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET — this gate reads built output`. It needs every one of the workspace's 82 packages built, and this diff changes no emitted code (JSON data, one comment, a baseline row, a markdown table). This is a declared narrowing; CI builds the workspace and runs it.
  - `check:lean-entry-closure` exited 3 on its first run, before `@objectstack/objectql` was built. After that build it exits 0: `2 published condition(s) measured from a real load`.
- **ESLint, narrowed and proven.** Of the 5 changed paths, 1 is in eslint's population (`files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}']` in `eslint.config.mjs`; the other four are JSON or markdown). `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config --format json packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`: exit 0, 1 file, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Invariance: the config never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rule sets), so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- **Rows not in this card's scope still cite `@940ba24` with line numbers.** They are the `NavigationRenderer` / `ContextSelectors` / `RootLandingRedirect` / `surfaceAgent` legs, which never named `AppSidebar`. They were left as they are.
- **Stale `rest-server.ts` pointers inside `note` prose** remain on the `areas.navigation` (`:1870`) and `navigation.children` (`:1837`) rows. The file `_note` already records that the gate now lives in `meta-item-read-gate.ts#filterAppForUserWithReason`. `note` is not scanned by any gate. Left alone, because it is outside this card.
